name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: A responsive media container that reserves exact bounds before content loads, with cover or contain fitting and four corner options.
example:
<AspectRatio ratio={16 / 9} fit="cover" radius="medium">
  <ImageArtwork image={{src: '/carousel/coral-arch.webp'}} alt="Coral paper arch" />
</AspectRatio>
